title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Arena on 1973-06-26
lineage: AUDMC > Reel > Reel > DAT > WAV > SHN
source: Audience Recording: FOB, Sony EMC mics spread out across the row > TC-152 master cassette > Amick's Reel recorded at 7-1/2ips > Reel(w/ Dolby)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording that captures the high‑energy ’73 jam vibe, highlighted by a stellar The Other One, though splices and uneven levels are noticeable.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its vibrant improvisation and especially the outstanding rendition of The Other One, reflecting the band’s classic 1973 sound. While two reviewers describe the tape as “awesome” and “wonderful,” one notes splice‑related roughness and unbalanced levels, making the recording solid but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is rated highly for musical energy and standout moments, while the recording is generally good with some technical flaws; weighted average yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splices on a couple of songs and uneven level balance are mentioned, but the tape still conveys the typical 1973 audience ambience with clear, lively sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1973 set flow with strong improvisational sections and tight transitions between jams.
